steps.message:
The project directory is inside a git-ignored path, so `git diff` is empty — here are the changes directly.

## Root cause

In the player fragments and the video grid's three-dot menu, the click handler calls `ChannelActionHandler.handleChannelActions(...)` **first**, and that handler claimed the generic menu IDs `R.id.share` / `R.id.copyurl`. Those exact IDs are also used by the *video* menus (`video_options_menu.xml`, `menu_youtube_player.xml`), so tapping "Copy URL" on a video never reached `youTubeVideo.copyUrl()` — it was swallowed by the channel handler and returned the channel URL.

Secondly, `YouTubeChannel.getChannelUrl()` passed the raw `id` field to `YoutubeChannelLinkHandlerFactory.getUrl()`. When the stored id is already a full URL (`https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC…`), the factory prepends the base URL again — producing exactly the doubled URL from the report: `https://www.youtube.com/https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCKvfz…`.

## Patch

**1. `app/src/main/res/menu/channel_options_menu.xml`** — channel-only IDs, no longer colliding with the video menus:
- `@+id/share` → `@+id/share_channel`, `@+id/copyurl` → `@+id/copyurl_channel`

**2. `ChannelActionHandler.java`** — handles the new channel-specific IDs (so `share`/`copyurl` now fall through to the video handling), plus a null-channel guard that prevents an NPE when a video has no resolved channel:
```java
public boolean handleChannelActions(Context context, @Nullable YouTubeChannel channel, int itemId) {
    if (channel == null) {
        return false;
    }
    switch (itemId) {
        ...
        case R.id.share_channel:   SkyTubeApp.shareUrl(context, channel.getChannelUrl()); return true;
        case R.id.copyurl_channel: SkyTubeApp.copyUrl(context, "Channel URL", channel.getChannelUrl()); return true;
```

**3. `YouTubeChannel.getChannelUrl()`** — normalize the id before building the link:
```java
final String plainId = getChannelId().getRawId();   // strips any "…channel/" prefix
return YoutubeChannelLinkHandlerFactory.getInstance().getUrl(plainId);
```

**4. `video_options_menu.xml`, `main/res/menu/menu_youtube_player.xml`, `extra/res/menu/menu_youtube_player.xml`** — added `share_channel` / `copyurl_channel` items inside the existing "Channel related" submenu, so sharing the channel URL is still reachable from a video, just properly labelled instead of hijacking the video action.

## Result
- Video "Copy URL" / "Share" now yields `https://youtu.be/<videoId>` (via `YouTubeVideo.getVideoUrl()`), matching the expected behaviour.
- Channel "Copy URL" yields a well-formed `https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC…` with no duplicated prefix.
- `./gradlew clean assembleDebug` → **BUILD SUCCESSFUL** (both `oss` and `extra` flavours).

In this Android project (NewPipe-like), find the code that handles "Copy Url" / share URL for a video/stream item, especially in long-press menus or the three-dot menu. Look for code building urls like "https://www.youtube.com/" + something, or getUrl()/getOriginalUrl() usage in share/copy actions. Report file paths and relevant code snippets with line numbers. Be thorough - check ShareUtils, StreamDialogEntry, StreamDialogDefaultEntry, VideoDetailFragment, and any place that concatenates a base url with a stream url.

The project directory is inside a git-ignored path, so `git diff` is empty — here are the changes directly.

## Root cause

In the player fragments and the video grid's three-dot menu, the click handler calls `ChannelActionHandler.handleChannelActions(...)` **first**, and that handler claimed the generic menu IDs `R.id.share` / `R.id.copyurl`. Those exact IDs are also used by the *video* menus (`video_options_menu.xml`, `menu_youtube_player.xml`), so tapping "Copy URL" on a video never reached `youTubeVideo.copyUrl()` — it was swallowed by the channel handler and returned the channel URL.

Secondly, `YouTubeChannel.getChannelUrl()` passed the raw `id` field to `YoutubeChannelLinkHandlerFactory.getUrl()`. When the stored id is already a full URL (`https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC…`), the factory prepends the base URL again — producing exactly the doubled URL from the report: `https://www.youtube.com/https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCKvfz…`.

## Patch

**1. `app/src/main/res/menu/channel_options_menu.xml`** — channel-only IDs, no longer colliding with the video menus:
- `@+id/share` → `@+id/share_channel`, `@+id/copyurl` → `@+id/copyurl_channel`

**2. `ChannelActionHandler.java`** — handles the new channel-specific IDs (so `share`/`copyurl` now fall through to the video handling), plus a null-channel guard that prevents an NPE when a video has no resolved channel:
```java
public boolean handleChannelActions(Context context, @Nullable YouTubeChannel channel, int itemId) {
    if (channel == null) {
        return false;
    }
    switch (itemId) {
        ...
        case R.id.share_channel:   SkyTubeApp.shareUrl(context, channel.getChannelUrl()); return true;
        case R.id.copyurl_channel: SkyTubeApp.copyUrl(context, "Channel URL", channel.getChannelUrl()); return true;
```

**3. `YouTubeChannel.getChannelUrl()`** — normalize the id before building the link:
```java
final String plainId = getChannelId().getRawId();   // strips any "…channel/" prefix
return YoutubeChannelLinkHandlerFactory.getInstance().getUrl(plainId);
```

**4. `video_options_menu.xml`, `main/res/menu/menu_youtube_player.xml`, `extra/res/menu/menu_youtube_player.xml`** — added `share_channel` / `copyurl_channel` items inside the existing "Channel related" submenu, so sharing the channel URL is still reachable from a video, just properly labelled instead of hijacking the video action.

## Result
- Video "Copy URL" / "Share" now yields `https://youtu.be/<videoId>` (via `YouTubeVideo.getVideoUrl()`), matching the expected behaviour.
- Channel "Copy URL" yields a well-formed `https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC…` with no duplicated prefix.
- `./gradlew clean assembleDebug` → **BUILD SUCCESSFUL** (both `oss` and `extra` flavours).
